name: GoogleAds Audiences
shortInfo: Define your audience and advertise to people important to your business on Google
about:
Grow your business with Google Ads. Get in front of customers when they're searching for businesses like yours on Google Search and Maps.  
  
Learn more about [Google Ads Audiences.](https://ads.google.com/intl/en_IN/home/?pli=1)
availableSync:
[Audience List Upload](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/googleads/syncs/audience-list-upload.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve audience list upload data from a user specified data warehouse to the Googles Ads platform.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/googleads/index.html) here.
